title: Show dependency/blocker status in list output
description:
Display blocker indicators in list view to show which issues are ready vs blocked:

Example:
  4622175c [uc] [TODO] Documentation ✓
  0c580f95 [uc] [TODO] Bulk operations ⚠ (blocked by: d5c4b02b)
  d5c4b02b [uc] [TODO] Fuzzy search → (blocking: 0c580f95)

Indicators:
- ✓ or (ready) - No incomplete required_for dependencies
- ⚠ or (blocked by: <ids>) - Has required_for pointing to incomplete issues
- → or (blocking: <ids>) - Other issues depend on this (informational)

Benefits:
- See at a glance what's actionable
- Understand why issues can't be started
- Prioritize work based on blockers

Complements 'pebbles next' command by showing status inline.

Relationships:
  part of ad694828 (Navigation and Project Visibility Epic)
